description.value:
You create a purely visual image, no larger than a 15-foot cube, at a point within range for the duration; anything passing through it exposes it as false.

As an action, you may move the image anywhere else within range, altering its motion so it appears natural. A creature that spends its action studying the image can see through it with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your tech save DC.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
